description: This file defines the Request class and related performance tracking classes within the WPEFramework PluginHost namespace. It includes request handling, state management, and optional performance statistics tracking for requests, as well as a JSONRPC tracking class.
published: Request::Service(const uint32_t, const Core::ProxyType<PluginHost::Service>&, const bool)

classes.name: Request
classes.description: Represents an incoming request, managing its state, associated service, and whether it is a service call.

classes.name: PerformanceAdministrator
classes.description: Conditionally compiled class for tracking performance statistics related to request processing.

classes.name: Statistics
classes.description: Holds statistical data for request processing times and metrics.

classes.name: DataSet
classes.description: Stores individual timing metrics for deserialization, thread pool, execution, communication, serialization, and total time.

classes.name: Tuple
classes.description: Aggregates statistical measurements, providing methods to clear, measure, and retrieve min, max, average, and count.

classes.name: TrackingJSONRPC
classes.description: Tracks timing and statistics for JSON-RPC message processing, including methods to record different stages and store metrics.

methods.name: Request::ServiceCall()
methods.description: Returns true if the request was received over the service prefix path.

methods.name: Request::State()
methods.description: Returns the current state of the request.

methods.name: Request::Service()
methods.description: Returns a reference to the service associated with the request.

methods.name: Request::Service(const uint32_t, const Core::ProxyType<PluginHost::Service>&, const bool)
methods.description: Associates a service with the request and sets error code and service call status.

methods.name: PerformanceAdministrator::Instance()
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of the performance administrator.

methods.name: PerformanceAdministrator::Store()
methods.description: Stores statistical data for a given package size.

methods.name: PerformanceAdministrator::Retrieve()
methods.description: Retrieves statistics for a given package size.

methods.name: TrackingJSONRPC::In()
methods.description: Records the time when data is received.

methods.name: TrackingJSONRPC::Out()
methods.description: Records the time when data is sent.

methods.name: TrackingJSONRPC::Acquire()
methods.description: Marks the start of a request processing cycle.

methods.name: TrackingJSONRPC::Relinquish()
methods.description: Marks the end of a request processing cycle and stores the collected statistics.
